title: Growth Data Foundation
description: Connect and normalize traffic, product, billing, and feedback data with durable customer identity, event quality, freshness, and provenance — the data your AI Growth Analyst reasons over.
setup_prompt: Set up my AI Growth Analyst's data foundation. Preserve my source-of-truth and privacy policies, connect only authorized traffic, product, billing, and feedback sources, stitch visitor-to-account identity with provenance, validate event quality and revenue reconciliation, and create a durable data-quality report.

setup_inputs.label: Product, domains, apps, and pricing model
Authorized analytics, billing, and feedback sources
History window, refresh frequency, and timezone
Retention, consent, restricted fields, and metric ownership
Customer event taxonomy and KPI definitions

recommended_tools.name: PostHog, Mixpanel, or Amplitude MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized product events, funnels, cohorts, and feature flags

recommended_tools.name: Stripe or Shopify MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized subscriptions, orders, invoices, and refunds for revenue reconciliation

recommended_tools.name: Web analytics and search-console MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized traffic sources, campaigns, and landing-page performance

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Persist normalized customer records, identity links, sync state, and quality findings

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether collected data supports important growth decisions
Collection cost, coverage, and measurement priorities
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge
